title: Like cheesecloth
text:
Like cheesecloth. The pattern on these ‘light filtering’ curtains is pretty. Unfortunately, the material is just like cheesecloth. No way these can be used for curtains, unless you want to go to jail. All of your neighbors will learn all about your ‘business’.
If you want super pretty sheers with no privacy, these are for you. If you want real curtains, keep scrolling.
